standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of the quotient of an algebraic space by a free finite group action
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, label spaces-properties-lemma-quotient (cited at statement line 1149)
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the quotient $U = W/G$ and the quotient morphism $q : W \to U$ whose pushforward of the constant sheaf carries the group action.

standard_prerequisites.name: The quotient morphism is a torsor, so the pushforward of the constant sheaf is finite locally free
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Torsor description of $q : W \to U$ with $U' = W$ (proof lines 1162-1165)
standard_prerequisites.use: It makes $q_*\underline{\mathbf{Z}}$ a finite locally free $\mathbf{Z}$-module with $G$-action, whose stalks are $\mathbf{Z}[G]$ and which splits after restricting to $U'$.

core_obligations: Use that $q : W \to U$ is a $G$-torsor (with $U' = W$) to see that $q_*\underline{\mathbf{Z}}$ is a finite locally free $\mathbf{Z}$-module with a $G$-action (proof lines 1162-1166).

Identify the geometric stalks $G$-equivariantly with $\mathbf{Z}[G]$, and record the projection formula $H^0(W, \mathcal{F}|_W) = H^0(U, \mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathbf{Z}} q_*\underline{\mathbf{Z}})$ checked after restricting to $U'$ (proof lines 1166-1184).

Define $\underline{\mathbf{Z}}(\chi) = (q_*\underline{\mathbf{Z}})^\chi$ as the subsheaf of sections transforming by $\chi$, compute its stalks as $\mathbf{Z}\cdot\sum_g \chi(g)g$, and conclude that it is locally free of rank one (proof lines 1184-1199).

Show that the $\chi$-semi-invariants of $\mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathbf{Z}} q_*\underline{\mathbf{Z}}$ are $\mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathbf{Z}} \underline{\mathbf{Z}}(\chi)$ by checking on stalks, and take global sections to obtain the displayed identification (proof lines 1200-1209).
proof_roadmap: The torsor structure and the pushforward of the constant sheaf (proof lines 1162-1166).
Stalks and the projection formula (proof lines 1166-1184).
The sign sheaf and its rank (proof lines 1184-1199).
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the rank one locally free sign sheaf attached to a character of a free finite group action on an algebraic space, and identifies the $\chi$-invariant sections over the cover with the sections of the twisted sheaf over the quotient (statement lines 1145-1159). The proof uses the torsor structure to recognise the pushforward of the constant sheaf as finite locally free with $G$-action, computes stalks and a projection formula, cuts out the character eigensheaf and identifies the semi-invariants at the level of stalks. The eigensheaf construction and the stalk identification are the substance, so the claim is H2.
